title: Full Codebase Modularization & Real-Time GitHub Update System
message: refactor(modularization): ensure 100% compliance with <=300 lines rule and live update alerts
changelog: Replaced hardcoded update modal with live GitHub repository update checker and changelog viewer
Display update warning with copyable git pull & rebuild instructions when newer version is detected
Added statusbar update notification pill for unobtrusive background release alerts
Categorized Settings Modal with dedicated internal sidebar tabs (General, WARP, Cookies, Security)
IDM-style sidebar categorization with Unfinished, Finished, and Source filters (Google Drive, Discord)
Strict codebase modularization ensuring 100% of files are <= 300 lines across backend and frontend
